p: princes which he had: That is, his chief officers.
Azariah the son of Zadok the: He was the son of Achimais and Zadok's nephew.
Abiathar were the priests: Not Abiathar whom Solomon had put from his office, 1Ki 2:27 but another of that name.
Jair the son of Manasseh: Which bore Jair's name, because he took them from the Canaanites, Nu 32:41.
Issachar: Solomon did not observe the division that Joshua made, but divided it as might best serve his purposes.
eating and drinking: They lived in all peace and security.
river unto the land of the: Which is the Euphrates.
kings on this side the river: For they were all tributaries to him.
Dan even to Beersheba: Throughout all Israel.
largeness of heart: Meaning, great understanding and able to comprehend all things.
east country: That is, the philosophers and astronomers who were judged most wise.
proverbs: Which for the most part are thought to have perished in the captivity of Babylon.
hyssop that springeth out of the: From the highest to the lowest.
